entry.title: Torre dei Lamberti
entry.note: Exact Q1819804 tower footprint way138829597. The operator photographs DSCF8933 and DSCF8939-1 are viewed southeastward from Palazzo Maffei at the northwest end of Piazza delle Erbe: the broad northwest face has the small arched window, and the adjoining southwest face has the clock. Native +Z is that southwest clock face (bearing about 245.38 degrees); +X points southeast. The adjacent Palazzo della Ragione wings and Arco della Costa are separate buildings and are not included in this tower mesh. Ordinary ground contact. Attached Palazzo della Ragione and Arco della Costa are separate structures, so their volumes are not duplicated in this tower asset. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
